title: RNA Extraction and Quantitative PCR for Inflammatory Gene Expression
author: OLIVIA HARDING
materials: Gently pipet up and down to mix.
Adjust volumes to 50 µL with water.
Can store this at Room temperature 24:00:00 .

steps.title: Homogenize Cells
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL cold TRIzol per million cells directly onto the cells and pipet up and down to homogenize.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature, then add chloroform to separate phases.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL chloroform per mL of TRIzol.
Mix by inversion until the solution is a cloudy homogenous mixture.
Incubate for 2 to 3 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 12 x g at 4 °C until the solution separates into a red phenol-chloroform bottom phase, an organic phase, and a colorless aqueous top phase.

steps.title: Isolate RNA
steps.instruction: Collect the aqueous phase and precipitate the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Carefully pipette out the aqueous phase (top) into a new tube by angling the tube at 45 °C.
Add 500 µL isopropanol to the aqueous phase per 1 mL TRIzol used.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 12 x g at 4 °C to pellet the RNA as a white, gel-like mass.

steps.title: Wash and Dry RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet and prepare it for resuspension.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL 75% EtOH per 1 mL Trizol used.
Vortex quickly, then centrifuge for 5 minutes at 7.5 x g at 4 °C.
Air dry the pellet for 5 to 10 minutes (do not dry completely; it should start to clarify over drying).

steps.title: Resuspend and Denature RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA and heat to denature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 50 µL RNase free water by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at 60 °C for 10 to 15 minutes.
Set the heat bath or block to 65 °C.

steps.title: Prepare First-Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Prepare reagents and set up the reverse transcription reaction.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 5X first-strand buffer and 0.1 M DTT at room temperature immediately before use (refreeze immediately after).
Measure RNA concentration using NanoDrop and calculate the volume needed for 5 µg of RNA.
To 5 µg RNA, add 1 µL 10 mM dNTP Mix (equal parts each base), 1 µL of oligo(dT)20 (50 µM), and sterile water to a total volume of 13 µL.
Heat at 65 °C for 5 minutes, then set the heat bath or block to 70 °C.
Incubate on ice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Complete the reverse transcription and inactivate the enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 µL First-strand buffer, 1 µL 0.1 M DTT, 1 µL RNase OUT inhibitor, and 1 µL SuperScript III.
Incubate at 50 °C for 45 minutes, then set the heat source to 65 °C.
Inactivate by heating to 70 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Purify cDNA
steps.instruction: Purify the cDNA using a Zymo-Spin Column.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL 0.5 M EDTA and 5 µL 1 M NaOH to each sample and mix by inversion.
Heat at 65 °C for 15 minutes.
Add 100 µL Oligo Binding Buffer to each 50 µL sample.
Add 400 µL ethanol, mix briefly by pipetting, and transfer to a Zymo-Spin Column.
Centrifuge at 10 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature and discard flow through.
Add 750 µL DNA Wash Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 10 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature and discard flow through.
Centrifuge at max speed for 1 minute at room temperature.
Transfer the column to a new clean tube and add 15 µL water to the matrix.
Centrifuge at 10 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature to elute.

steps.title: Quantify and Store cDNA
steps.instruction: Measure the final concentration and store the product.

substeps.instruction: Measure 260/280 ratio for final concentration.
Save the product at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Calculate and mix the components for the SYBR Green qPCR reactions.

substeps.instruction: Plan volumes based on the number of primer sets (p) and replicates (n). For one reaction (total 11 µL), use 5.5 µL SYBR Master Mix, 0.33 µL primer, and up to 11 ng cDNA.
Mix the SYBR Master Mix, cDNA (1:100 dilutions), and nuclease-free water according to the calculated worksheet volumes.
Centrifuge the mix quickly.

steps.title: Distribute and Load qPCR Plate
steps.instruction: Aliquot the reaction mix and add specific primers.

substeps.instruction: Split the mix into tubes (e.g., 8 tubes) with the volume required for the replicates (e.g., 3 replicates * 10 µL = 30 µL per tube).
Add the required volume of each primer (10 µM stock) to reach the final volume (e.g., 0.33 µL * 3 = 1 µL primer per tube, totaling ~32 µL).
Mix again, centrifuge, and add 10 µL of each reaction to the wells.
Seal the plate with an adhesive cover and centrifuge to remove air bubbles.

steps.title: Run qPCR and Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Run the reaction in the QuantStudio and analyze the results.

substeps.instruction: Perform UDG activation: 50 °C for 2 min.
Perform Dual Lock DNA polymerase activation: 95 °C for 2 min.
Cycle 40 times: Denature (95 °C, 15 sec), Anneal (56 °C or variable, 15 sec), Extend (72 °C, 1 min).
Perform Dissociation curve: 1.6 °C/sec to 95 °C (15 sec), 2.1.6 °C/sec to 60 °C (1 min), and 3.0.15 °C/sec to 95 °C (15 sec).
Export data as an .xls file and analyze using the ΔΔ method.
